fields.statement: QA cycle 2 at 76c40f51, built binary in a scratch Rhiza root (fake rex on PATH, one-step command workflows plan/bugfix/other in .rhiza/workflows, RHIZA_* unset): rhiza check with .rhiza/dispatch.toml '[ready] milestone = "bugfix"' now fails: '[ready] unknown key "milestone": want one of feature, bug'; [foo] fails 'unknown table [foo]', bug = 3 fails 'want a workflow name as a string, got int64', '../x' fails 'is not a bare workflow name'; [ready] bug = "bugfix", [request] milestone = "other" and [ready] feature = "ship-change" pass. With no file the daemon picks plan for requests and ship-change for a ready change set.

QA cycle 2 at 76c40f51, built binary in a scratch Rhiza root (fake rex on PATH, one-step command workflows plan/bugfix/other in .rhiza/workflows, RHIZA_* unset): rhiza check passes with no dispatch file, with [ready] bug naming repo workflow bugfix and with [ready] feature naming built-in ship-change; it fails naming ready.bug for a missing workflow 'nope', and for 'personal-only', which exists only in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/rhiza/workflows; it fails on unknown table [foo] and on [ready] milestone.

QA cycle 2 at 76c40f51, built binary in a scratch Rhiza root (fake rex on PATH, one-step command workflows plan/bugfix/other in .rhiza/workflows, RHIZA_* unset): run start --dry-run on bug change sets: with no file the default ship-change ('has no leaves: ship-change builds...'); with [ready] bug = "other" 'Workflow: other, Picked by: rule ready.bug'; --workflow bugfix gives 'Picked by: explicit'; a change set whose request named bugfix gives 'Workflow: bugfix, Picked by: request' even beside a broken file. With '[ready] bug = 3' the start now exits 1 with the file's load error and never falls back to ship-change; --workflow other still starts.

QA cycle 2 at 76c40f51, built binary in a scratch Rhiza root (fake rex on PATH, one-step command workflows plan/bugfix/other in .rhiza/workflows, RHIZA_* unset): daemon --once on an accepted milestone change set: with '[ready] feature = 3' no run starts and daemon status shows workflow-unresolved with ready.feature, 'the [ready] rule for feature in .rhiza/dispatch.toml' and the load error; rhiza inbox lists 'change set "Built": no run started: ... does not resolve'. With feature = "nope" the skip names nope and its rule. Once feature = "other", the poll starts the run with --workflow other --pick rule ready.feature.

QA cycle 2 at 76c40f51, built binary in a scratch Rhiza root (fake rex on PATH, one-step command workflows plan/bugfix/other in .rhiza/workflows, RHIZA_* unset): rhiza request 'login fails' --kind bug --workflow bugfix queued it, and request ls --json shows workflow bugfix; request --workflow nope exited 2 ('there is no such workflow') with nothing queued; its plan run opened a change set whose change show --json has workflow bugfix, and run start --dry-run on it picks bugfix by 'request'.

QA cycle 2 at 76c40f51, built binary in a scratch Rhiza root (fake rex on PATH, one-step command workflows plan/bugfix/other in .rhiza/workflows, RHIZA_* unset): change show --json for the change set the bug request's plan run opened gives request_kind bug, with workflow bugfix when the request named it and null otherwise; a change set from rhiza change new shows request_kind feature, workflow null.

QA cycle 2 at 76c40f51, built binary in a scratch Rhiza root (fake rex on PATH, one-step command workflows plan/bugfix/other in .rhiza/workflows, RHIZA_* unset): With [request] bug = "bugfix" and milestone = "other", the daemon logs 'starting the plan run ... with workflow bugfix (picked by rule request.bug)' and detaches run start --workflow bugfix --pick rule request.bug --new ...; a feature request gets plan (picked by default); the milestone request gets --workflow other --milestone, without --autonomous. run start --foreground --workflow bugfix --new ... --request ran to success, and the request's change set records request_kind bug.

QA cycle 2 at 76c40f51, built binary in a scratch Rhiza root (fake rex on PATH, one-step command workflows plan/bugfix/other in .rhiza/workflows, RHIZA_* unset): run ls --json shows pick 'rule request.bug' for the bugfix plan run and 'explicit' for --workflow plan runs; run start --dry-run prints 'Picked by:' with rule ready.bug, request or explicit; the daemon's start lines name the pick ('picked by rule ready.feature', 'picked by default').
